annotations.title: Get the public AI visibility report of a domain

description: Returns the latest public AI visibility report of a domain from QQQ (qqq.ee), when someone has already run the full check on qqq.ee: report date, market and field, in how many search-grounded ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude answers the company was named, how often its own website was cited, a summary per AI engine, the questions asked, the cited source domains and short answer excerpts, plus the link to the report page. Reads the stored report only: no website is fetched, no AI model is asked and no new report is created. Without a report, says so and links the full check on qqq.ee. Read-only, no limit.

domain.description: Website domain or URL, for example example.com or https://www.example.com/.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the qqq.ee links: en (English, default) or et (Estonian).

name: get_public_report
title: Get the public AI visibility report of a domain
